title: Secrets answer
description: The 200 answer to the secrets request: the envelope, the stored values sealed with HPKE base mode to the access key the request verified under. The runner verifies sig under its pinned apiary_public_key before opening, checks the identifiers against its own and exp against its clock, then builds info and aad from its own values alone. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object. Every binary value is base64url without padding. At most 5 MiB.

version.description: The document format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

suite.description: RFC 9180 base mode with DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) 0x0020, HKDF-SHA256 0x0001 and AES-256-GCM 0x0002.

access_key_id.description: The access key the values are sealed to, the one the request verified under: ak_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

run_configuration.description: The run configuration's digest of the request, sha256= and 64 lower-case hex digits.

exp.description: When the envelope expires: the server's clock at sealing plus 600 seconds, in decimal seconds since the Unix epoch. The runner refuses an envelope whose exp passed more than 300 seconds ago or lies more than 900 seconds ahead. It is a JSON integer below 2^53, with no sign, fraction or exponent; the runner checks the form when it decodes.

enc.description: The encapsulated key: the sender's fresh ephemeral X25519 public key, 32 bytes.

ct.description: The ciphertext of the sealed plaintext, sealed-plaintext.schema.json, followed by the 16-byte tag: base64url without padding, every bit after the last full byte zero.

sig.description: The Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes, under the server's signing key, over lp32("qory envelope v1") || lp32(suite) || lp32(access_key_id) || lp32(run_id) || lp32(run_configuration) || lp32(exp in canonical decimal) || lp32(enc, raw) || lp32(ct, raw), where lp32 is a u32 big-endian length, then the bytes.
